service_setup.bad_email: That does not look like an email: it should look like name@gmail.com.
service_setup.email_privacy: The email is sent only to MyMemory, together with translation requests.
service_setup.email_text: Enter your email and the limit immediately becomes 50,000 characters a day (about 30 screens of text). No registration or email confirmation is needed.
service_setup.email_title: Translate up to 50,000 characters a day
service_setup.google_instead: Connect Google instead of an email…
service_setup.google_text: A Google account is required. Google will ask you to link a bank card for verification; within the free allowance no money is charged. Do the steps in order: each button opens the right page in your browser.
service_setup.key_bad_form: That does not look like a Google Cloud key: it starts with “AIza” and is 39 characters long.
service_setup.key_empty: Paste the key first (step 4: copy it on the “Keys” page).
service_setup.limit_sub: Without an email, MyMemory translates 5,000 characters a day.
service_setup.limit_sub_wait: Without an email, MyMemory translates 5,000 characters a day. The limit resets in {wait}.
service_setup.limit_title: Today's free translation has run out
